description: Agent-based, network-coupled simulation of mask-wearing adoption under social influence, policy, supply, media, and disease transmission. Individuals interact in households, workplaces/schools, and public locations with mandates and enforcement. Mask supply and price dynamics, messaging, and risk perception jointly shape adoption and compliance; optional disease transmission coupling feeds back via perceived risk.

modules.name: PopulationAndNetworkBuilder
modules.description: One-time construction of agents, households, social network (small-world with homophily), workplaces, public locations, media channels, and retailers; assign initial states.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  set RNG(seed)
  create N=population_size Persons with attributes
  assign age_group via age_group_shares
  assign income via Gini-based generator
  form households with mean household_size_mean; set household_id
  create workplaces/schools with mean workplace_size_mean; assign workplace_id by age
  build small-world graph G(N, avg_degree, p_rewire) then rewire to achieve homophily_by_mask_attitude
  add social_neighbors from G
  create Locations per location_mix and capacities
  set location.contact_rate_modifier for types from params
  create Retailers (num_retailers), initialize inventory=population_size*supply_initial_inventory_per_capita/num_retailers, price=mask_price
  create MediaChannel instances (num_media_channels) with reach, sentiment, misinformation_rate
  initialize Person states: mask_status ~ Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate), mask_inventory ~ max(0, Normal(mean=mask_inventory_initial_mean, sd=mask_inventory_initial_sd)), health_state infected with prevalence initial_infected_prevalence
  compute mask_access_score from retailer proximity, income, and retailer_location_bias_to_high_income
  set trust_in_authorities ~ TruncatedNormal(trust_mean, trust_sd)
  set social_influence_susceptibility ~ Beta(2,2)
  set compliance_probability initial from trust, risk_perception, and mask_status
  emit constructed objects/signals
notes: Homophily implementation: assortative rewiring using initial mask attitude proxy (trust, risk) to match homophily parameter.
Location capacities can be proportional to population and mix proportions.
Retailer geographies can be implicit via access scores without explicit spatial coordinates.

modules.name: MediaRiskUpdater
modules.description: Updates risk perception per person from media exposure, local disease prevalence, and trust; updates media sentiment.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each MediaChannel m:
  m.sentiment <- clip(m.sentiment + Normal(0,0.02) + messaging_effect_size*policy.messaging_intensity - media_misinformation_rate*abs(misinformation_base_sentiment), -1, 1)
for each Person i:
  exposure <- sum_over_channels(m.reach * m.sentiment) / sum_over_channels(m.reach)
  local_risk <- current.infection_prevalence
  delta <- risk_perception_update_rate * ( 0.6*local_risk + 0.4*exposure * i.trust_in_authorities )
  i.risk_perception <- clip(i.risk_perception*(1 - risk_perception_update_rate) + delta, 0, 1)
notes: Exposure is weighted by channel reach; trust down-weights or up-weights impact.
If no media data, initialize sentiment to 0 and let messaging drive shifts.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcementEngine
modules.description: Activates mask mandates, sets enforcement, runs communication campaigns, applies subsidies/free distribution, and records enforcement interactions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
mandate_active <- (t >= mandate_start_day)
policy.enforcement_level <- enforcement_level
policy.messaging_intensity <- messaging_intensity
policy.subsidy_amount <- subsidy_amount
if distribution_program_active and (t % ceil(7/distribution_days_per_week) == 0):
  distribute free_masks_per_capita masks prioritized by low income using subsidy_targeting_low_income_bias
for each mandated Location L:
  set L.mask_requirement <- mandate_active
  set L.enforcement_strength <- clamp(Normal(location_enforcement_strength_mean, 0.1), 0, 1)
for each Person i cited for noncompliance:
  i.compliance_penalty_memory <- update with (amount=enforcement_penalty, decay=fine_decay_days)
notes: Distribution days per week approximated by periodicity.
Enforcement interactions (warnings/fines) update a memory that affects future compliance in AdoptionAndBehaviorEngine.

modules.name: SupplyAndRetailEngine
modules.description: Restocks retailers, sets prices, rations sales, and processes purchases by agents based on access, income, and price sensitivity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Retailer r:
  r.inventory <- r.inventory + restock_rate_per_day * r.inventory
  demand_signal <- aggregate expected demand from persons (desired_units = max(0, replacement_need - inventory))
  price_adjust <- 1 + 0.1 * sign(demand_signal - r.inventory)
  r.price <- max(0.1, mask_price * price_adjust)
for each Person i:
  desired <- max(0, replacement_interval_days - (t - i.last_replacement_day) <= 0 ? 1 : 0)
  affordable_price <- max(0, r.price - policy.subsidy_amount)
  affordability <- sigmoid( - price_elasticity_of_demand * affordable_price * (income_price_sensitivity / max(i.income_level, 0.1)) )
  purchase_qty <- min(desired, retailer_rationing_limit_per_purchase) * affordability * i.mask_access_score
  allocate purchase_qty across nearby retailers with inventory and apply distribution_delay_days
  i.mask_inventory += fulfilled_qty
  record supply metrics (avg inventory, price, unmet demand)
notes: Affordability increases with higher subsidy and higher income.
Price elasticity is negative; sigmoid ensures [0,1] purchase propensity.
Distribution delays can be modeled via order queues.

modules.name: AdoptionAndBehaviorEngine
modules.description: Computes adoption decisions, compliance in contexts, mask replacement, peer influence, and response to policy/enforcement.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each Person i:
  neighbor_adoption <- mean(mask_status of social_neighbors)
  perceived_benefit <- perceived_benefit_weight * ( i.risk_perception + social_influence_strength * peer_influence_weight * neighbor_adoption )
  perceived_cost <- perceived_cost_weight * max(0, effective_price(i) / max(i.income_level, 0.1))
  policy_push <- mandate_compliance_multiplier * policy.enforcement_level
  penalty_effect <- enforcement_deterrence_sensitivity * decayed_memory(i.compliance_penalty_memory, noncompliance_penalty_memory_days)
  threshold <- TruncatedNormal(adoption_threshold_mean, adoption_threshold_sd)
  adopt_prob <- sigmoid( perceived_benefit - perceived_cost + policy_push + penalty_effect - threshold )
  if rand() < adopt_prob and i.mask_inventory > 0: i.mask_status <- 1 else if i.mask_inventory == 0: i.mask_status <- 0
  i.compliance_probability <- clamp( adopt_prob * (policy.mandate_active ? mandate_compliance_multiplier : 1.0), 0, 1 )
  if t - i.last_replacement_day >= replacement_interval_days and i.mask_inventory > 0:
    i.mask_inventory -= 1; i.last_replacement_day <- t; i.compliance_probability <- i.compliance_probability * (1 - mask_decay_compliance_penalty)
notes: effective_price(i) reflects retailer price minus subsidy, weighted by access.
Threshold sampling can be per-person fixed at initialization for stability.

modules.name: ContactAndTransmissionEngine
modules.description: Simulates daily contacts across location types and infection transmission, accounting for mask use (source control and wearer protection) and mobility changes.

notes: Mobility reduction applied to infected/isolating persons.
Contacts stratified by location mix; attendance reduced by workplace_attendance_rate and public_activity_rate.

modules.name: AggregationAndReporting
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and derives metrics like adoption rate, incidence, Rt, equity gaps, compliance in mandated locations, average mask availability, policy cost, and NPI effectiveness.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption <- mean(person.mask_status)
append to series adoption_rate_daily
peak_adoption_rate <- max(series adoption_rate_daily)
time_to_50 <- first t where adoption_rate_daily >= 0.5
incidence <- count(epidemic.new_infections today)
cumulative_infections <- cumulative sum
Rt_daily <- epidemic.Rt_estimate
adoption_low_income <- mean(mask_status where income <= low_income_threshold_quantile)
adoption_high_income <- mean(mask_status where income >= 1 - low_income_threshold_quantile)
equity_gap <- adoption_high_income - adoption_low_income
compliance_mandated <- mean(mask_status among visitors in locations with mask_requirement)
avg_inventory <- mean(person.mask_inventory)
policy_cost_daily <- subsidies_paid + enforcement_costs (e.g., admin) - fines_collected
npi_effectiveness <- estimate averted infections = baseline_no_mask_incidence_proxy - incidence
notes: Baseline proxy can be computed as incidence / (1 - average_effective_mask_reduction) to approximate counterfactual.
Income thresholds computed from distribution implied by low_income_threshold parameter.

Type of social network; fixed to small-world.

Initial supply per capita across retailers.

Mean threshold for adoption utility difference.
Effect of policy messaging on media sentiment and risk perception.
Multiplier on compliance probability under mandates.
Max masks sold per purchase per person.
Days between purchase order and fulfillment.
Average population reach of media signals.
Baseline sentiment of misinformation (negative reduces adoption).
Whether free mask distribution is active.
Number of distribution days per week.
Masks distributed per person on distribution days.
Reduction in compliance when replacement overdue.
Elasticity of demand with respect to price.
Scales effect of income on price sensitivity.
Additional scaling on neighbor adoption influence.
Fraction of infections that are asymptomatic.
Share attending workplaces/schools on a given day.
Share engaging in public activities on a given day.
Decay horizon for enforcement penalty effects.
Gini coefficient to shape income distribution.
Bias factor for targeting subsidies/distribution to low-income.
Accessibility bias of retailers favoring high-income zones.

observables.formula_or_field: mean(mask_status among Person present in mandated Locations)

algorithms.WattsStrogatzSmallWorld: Constructs social network with given average degree; then adjust for homophily via assortative rewiring.
algorithms.WeightedThresholdAdoption: Adoption probability modeled as sigmoid of (benefits - costs - threshold), with neighbor adoption weighted by social_influence_strength.
algorithms.CompartmentalProgression: Discrete-time SEIR-like state progression with incubation and infectious periods.
algorithms.RtEstimation: Daily Rt computed as new_infections / infectious_population adjusted by generation time.
algorithms.AssortativeRewiring: Rewires edges to increase attribute assortativity to match homophily target.
algorithms.PriorityDistribution: Allocates free masks prioritizing low-income agents with a bias parameter.
